card.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
card.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.

mechanism: A seeks formal certification for invisible construction by escalating confidence from metaphor to load-bearing material.
confusable: Unlike generic magical assurance, A must convert each objection into a stranger reason for a signature.
comparison: An inspector's own certainty becomes support, whereas the wedding proposal stores and seals future weather.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
